_comment: The /v1/vms/{id}/... requests that BOTH FluxVM clients make (agent-runtime/src/fluxvm.rs and backend/crates/fluxvm-client). Each client has a test that replays these calls against a recording server and compares method, path and body. Change a shared call in one client and this file and the other client's test tell you. id is always 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 and tag is always t1. body: null = no body, "object" = any JSON object, otherwise exact JSON.
